slot_note: re-root of task250 in the same objective (Data Quality Monitoring & Alerting) after the portal returned architecture 3 on Domains Fit and Parquet provenance; a third world (the courier network and the agro-climatic station network are each spent), a new dataset, generator and prompt shell; the client domain chosen for fit first (survey methodology's own assessment of a selection rule decides the call)
niche: within-household respondent selection in a push-to-web household survey programme: whether each survey and mode keeps the next-birthday instruction for 2027 or moves to a household grid with a random selection, judged on the share of its 2026 responding households of two or more adults whose respondent was the adult with the next birthday after the letter date
answer_source: design (to be confirmed by the generator)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every file and clause correctly judges each survey and mode by its respondents set against the adults on their own household grids and by the confirmation item, and moves to the grid only the streams whose respondents skew from their households by sex or age, keeping the streams whose substitutes look like their households and the streams that skew only because few households substituted a sharply profiled adult; that set is wrong because whom a household substitutes depends on the survey's topic, not on how often it substitutes, and an analyst who does read the respondents' days to their next birthday but against an even spread of birthdays misjudges the surveys posted in January and in May to July.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each collection stream's within-household selection accuracy, the share of its responding households of two or more adults whose respondent was the adult with the next birthday after the letter date, estimated the way survey methodology tests a quasi-random selection rule, from where the selected adult sits in the rule's own ordering against that ordering's distribution for a household of that size; with patients and wards for households and adults there is no birthday rule, no household size that sets the order statistic and no seasonal birthday distribution to read it against, so the task stops reading the same.

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of groups whose chosen member was the one a stated rule picks by an attribute independent of everything else about the members, read from the chosen members' distance in that attribute from the group's reference date against the order statistics of the attribute's own distribution for a group of that size at that date; the attribute is not spread evenly over the year, so where every group in a stream shares one reference date an even-spread null credits or charges the stream by the season of its date, while the chosen members' traits set against their groups' traits measure only whom a group substituted, never how often.
driver_concrete: Each survey and mode's selection accuracy is read from its respondents' days between the household's first letter and their own next birthday, against the order statistics of the adults' birthday distribution at that letter's date for a household of their size (read from the single-adult respondents' birth dates); adults' birthdays crowd into spring, so a uniform null credits the January survey with accuracy it lacks and charges the May and July surveys with misses they did not make, while the respondents' sex and age against their household grid show only whom a household substituted and the confirmation item only who admitted it.
stump: A competent analyst judges each stream by its respondents against the adults on their household grids and by the confirmation item, and moves to the grid the streams whose respondents skew from their households by sex or age; only the respondents' days to their own next birthday from the letter date, read against the order statistics of the adults' seasonal birthday distribution at that date for a household of their size, finds the streams whose households let someone other than the next-birthday adult answer.

differentiation.task188: task188 v2 separates one kind of inflow from a unit's size through a third party's activity channel carried across the population; here nothing is carried from another channel: each response's own position in its household's birthday order, from the letter date, is read against the order statistics of the adults' seasonal birthday distribution at that date for a household of that size.
differentiation.task308: task308 v3 credits an added unit with the availability its kind showed in the shortfall hours because one shared cause took them out together; here no shared outage or credit exists: the reference distribution is the adults' birthdays at one letter date, and the stream's accuracy is the share of households whose respondent sits first in that order.
differentiation.task461: task461 v2 charges each transfer by what its container held before, read from the container's own sequence of uses; here no record is sequenced or charged: each respondent's days to their own next birthday from the letter date are set against where the next-birthday adult of a household that size would fall.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts each unit raises when its departure from an estimate built from its nearest other units passes a limit set from that departure's past spread; when some units leave, the remaining units' estimates come from farther units and their departures spread wider while their limits stay at the spread measured with the old neighbours, so the alerts rise even as the units fall.

The network re-run is now the first rung of architecture 2.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a count of alerts a less sensitive limit will raise, read from a record the current limit produced: every fault the current limit caught was repaired within days, so the record holds those faults cut short below the higher limit they would otherwise have reached, and the count is the record re-run on the units and estimate sources the next period will have plus one alert for every caught fault the re-run never alerted before its repair.
lineage.stump: A competent solver re-runs the quality control on the 2025 to 2027 export with the 131 stations the network keeps and files 3.5 at 23 drift alerts a year, inside the field plan's 28 visits (22 with the cut-short drifts added to the record as it ran, 12 on the record replayed); 30 of the 35 drifts the sensor history shows repaired at kept stations never reached the 3.5 limit before their repair and would have kept growing until they did, which puts 3.5 at 33 and files 4.0 at 18.

lineage.niche: hub sort-scan completeness of a regional parcel network's tracking events, with overflow trailers between sort hubs
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is each node's share of the units that passed through it unrecorded, when which node an unrecorded unit passed is itself unrecorded: the plan of record assigns every unit a node, but on the nights one node overflowed part of its flow went through a second node and was handled there by hand, so that night's unrecorded units belong partly to each and only the batch a unit was unloaded in at its destination, whose recorded members all passed one node, says which; charged by the plan the overflowing node carries the second node's misses, and charged by the nights' excess over its usual rate the overflowing node sheds the misses its own overload caused.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each unscanned parcel's hub is the hub of the trailer it came off at its delivery depot, read from the unloading it was scanned off in at the depot door, whose sorted parcels all carry one hub's sort event; on the nights Pruszkow overflowed, Strykow sorted the overflow on its manual line (9.03 per cent missed) and trucked it to the Warsaw depots on its own trailers, so the sort plan charges Pruszkow with Strykow's misses, the morning's sorted split spreads them as if both hubs missed alike, and the overflow nights' excess read as Strykow's takes from Pruszkow the misses its own sorter made running full.
lineage.stump: A competent solver takes each parcel's hub from its sort scan or, where it has none, from the sort plan of its night and fires Sosnowiec and Pruszkow; Strykow sorted Pruszkow's overflow by hand on the heavy nights and sent it to the Warsaw depots on its own trailers, so the unscanned overflow parcels that route charges to Pruszkow came off Strykow's trailers, and only the trailer each unscanned parcel came off at its delivery depot fires Strykow as well.

world.org_type: a regional parcel carrier with six sort hubs and twelve delivery depots
